## Frequently Asked Questions

### Does DataForSEO require a monthly subscription like most SEO tools?

 No. DataForSEO operates on a pay-as-you-go model with a simple $50 minimum deposit and no recurring fees. This is a significant advantage over competitors like Semrush, which requires a $499.95/month Business plan just to unlock API access. With DataForSEO, you only pay for the data you actually use with API credits that never expire.

### What happens to my unused DataForSEO credits at the end of the month?

 Unlike SerpApi, Oxylabs, and Semrush, DataForSEO credits never expire. We do not trust in the "use it or lose it" philosophy, making our service more cost-effective for businesses with variable data needs or occasional usage.

### Which SEO data provider is the easiest to integrate with LLM tools like Claude or ChatGPT?

 DataForSEO is the way to go because it provides an official MCP (Model Context Protocol) server, allowing for native integration with AI models like Claude. While alternatives like SerpApi and Oxylabs offer no-code integrations for Zapier or Make, DataForSEO’s support for MCP and a collections of ready-made no-code templates make it the superior choice for upgrading your AI agent and no-code workflows.

### Does DataForSEO offer SEO data beyond SERPs and scraped results?

 Yes, of course. While competitors like SerpApi focus almost entirely on SERP data and Oxylabs on web scraping and proxies, DataForSEO provides a massive ecosystem of 15+ specialized APIs. This includes Backlinks API, AI Optimization API, OnPage SEO data and more. This makes DataForSEO a "one-stop shop" for anyone who wants to build a comprehensive marketing analytics solution without having to deal with multiple vendors.

### Can DataForSEO handle high-concurrency needs for large-scale enterprise tools?

DataForSEO is built for scale, offering a rate limit of 10,000 requests per minute for most APIs. This is significantly more flexible than the 60 requests per minute limit imposed by Ahrefs. Also, DataForSEO’s infrastructure is specifically optimized to avoid the throttling common in other platforms.

### How does DataForSEO’s uptime and support compare to the competition?

 Reliability is a core strength for DataForSEO, maintaining a 99.95% uptime SLA and offering total transparency with a real-time [Status page](https://status.dataforseo.com/).
